name: Gen5W Split Screen Blocker
description: Removes the right-hand split screen, its slide-out tab and its pop-ups from every screen, including over CarPlay and Android Auto. To turn it off: in HMG-API, open Mods, pick Gen5W Split Screen Blocker, switch it off and tap Apply changes. The split screen comes back at the next screen change, even if HMG-API shows Restart needed. To turn it back on: switch it on, tap Apply changes, then tap Restart unit. Finds what it needs in each car's own split-screen app, so it isn't tied to one car or software version; anything it can't find on a car is left alone and named in its log.
